description: This is a PHP source file defining the PerformanceTrackerLogAPI class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. The class provides REST API endpoints for managing performance tracker logs, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting logs, along with validation rules and request handling logic.
